preview.text: England Champions play Australia Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. Australia Champions won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 34 degrees.

summary.text: Australia Champions won by 16 runs. AUSCH made 218-6, D Arcy Short top-scoring with 60 off 25 balls; Ravi Bopara (c) took 2 for 28. ENGCH made 202-4, Moeen Ali top-scoring with 94 off 43 balls; Ben Hilfenhaus took 2 for 27. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
